name: cortico-world-casino
description: 你的 AI 到底会不会打牌?装上就知道了。月下牌桌是一张藏在电脑里的绿呢牌桌,AI 坐你对面——不是念稿,是真打:看牌、算牌、诈唬,赢了一手还会嘴硬。三个游戏:21 点(庄家按死规则出牌,你可以放心使坏)、抽鬼牌(开局偷偷藏一张,终局揭晓谁揣着鬼牌,心理战拉满)、两人德州扑克(单挑限注,庄位轮转;劝一句:白扔盲注最亏,打宽点)。筹码按游戏分开记账,输了不用心疼——破产有救济金,离开自动挂起,回来接着打,终局当场喊「再来一局」。大厅能搜,发牌有动画,筹码按面额叠成小山。打开「AI 主动邀约」,它还会主动凑过来:来一把?筹码是游戏内数字,不涉真钱——钱包绝对安全,受伤的只有自尊。

en.description: Does your AI actually know how to play cards? Install this and find out. Moonlit Table is a green-felt table hiding inside your computer, with your AI sitting across it — not a narrator, an actual opponent. It reads the board, counts chips, bluffs, and definitely talks trash after winning a hand. Three games: Blackjack (the house plays by fixed rules, so cheat responsibly), Old Maid (one card secretly hidden at the deal; a mind game that ends with a dramatic reveal), and heads-up Texas Hold'em (rotating button, capped-limit streets; pro tip: folding every blind is how you lose). Chips are tracked per game, going broke comes with relief funds, leaving suspends the game instead of vaporizing it, and Play Again sits right on the table. Searchable lobby, deal animations, chips piled into tiny mountains. Flip on AI invitations and it will slide into your chat: one game? Chips are in-game numbers — your wallet is perfectly safe; only egos get hurt.
